title: Research dispatcher starved by repo-queued CI cap (141 min idle, 2026-10-28); starvation floor + receipt-PR wedge fix
note: Root cause MEASURED: 06:04Z (41 queued) and 07:10Z (25 queued) dispatch cycles deferred all 56-58 due units on 'N workflow runs queued repo-wide (> 10)'; 0 research in flight, 20/20 hosted-runner slots held by PR/push CI (Guards, pytest-run). Fix: dispatch_queue.starvation_override (limits.starvation_hours 1.5) lifts ONLY the repo-queued block for ONE fire/cycle; infra yield + unreadable gh unchanged. Second wedge fixed: stuck conflicting receipt PR #20788 made the in-flight-receipt check skip every later receipt+utilization landing; skip now only for receipt PRs < 90 min old. CLOSES WHEN: first dispatch cycle after merge that sees repo_queued > 10 logs 'starvation floor' and dispatches exactly 1 unit (or a cycle with queued <= 10 dispatches), and a receipt newer than run 40594257399 is on main. LEFTOVER for manager: #20787/#20788 are superseded (see lane report), close them.

observation.what: A dispatch cycle with repo_queued > 10 logs a starvation floor warning and fires exactly 1 unit; a receipt newer than run 40594257399 lands on main
observation.how_to_check: gh run view <research-queue-dispatch run> logs: grep starvation floor / dispatched; git log origin/main -- docs/claude/work/research-queue-dispatch-receipt.json

writeback.roadmap: none: pipeline/ops fix, no milestone outcome
